posts.en:
dsh-mmx-bridge is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a0277716a55fec33674c.html
